page.layout: One scanned image showing the outside of a book cover: a blind-tooled leather binding with decorative frames, corner ornaments and a central oval medallion. A checkered colour scale strip lies at the right edge. No printed page text is present.
page.notes: The scan shows the front board of a bound volume, not a printed page. The blind-tooled decoration (scrolled borders, corner fleurons and central oval roll) is ornament only. The checkered scale bar at the right edge is a photographic calibration target and is not printed text. No words, numbers or headings can be transcribed.
